SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notice_team nt WHERE nt.notice_no = n.notice_no AND nt.notice_team = #{notice_team} )
AND n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')

SELECT n.notice_no, n.notice_title, DATE(n.noticedate) AS noticedate, n.is_important, u.name AS username FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user u ON u.usernum = n.usernum WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notice_team nt WHERE nt.notice_no = n.notice_no AND nt.notice_team = #{notice_team} )
AND n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.notice_no DESC LIMIT #{offset}, 10
SELECT n.*, u.name AS username FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user u ON u.usernum = n.usernum WHERE n.notice_no = #{noticeNo}
SELECT notice_no, notice_team FROM notice_team WHERE notice_no = #{noticeNo} ORDER BY notice_team

SELECT n.notice_no, n.notice_title, n.notice_content, DATE(n.noticedate) AS noticedate, n.is_important, u.name AS username FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user u ON u.usernum = n.usernum ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.notice_no DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT n.notice_no, n.notice_title, n.notice_content, DATE(n.noticedate) AS noticedate, n.is_important, u.name AS username FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user u ON u.usernum = n.usernum WHERE #{admin} = TRUE OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notice_team nt WHERE nt.notice_no = n.notice_no AND (nt.notice_team = '999' OR nt.notice_team = #{teamCode}) ) ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.notice_no DESC LIMIT 5
